title: Nouns
info: A noun is a word for a person, place, thing, or idea.
Teacher, park, and book are nouns. A proper noun names a specific person or place and starts with a capital letter.
Common nouns are general (dog, city). Proper nouns are specific (Rover, London).
Nouns can be singular (one cat) or plural (two cats).
